description: This file defines the PerformanceTrackerDecorator class, a PHP class that adds additional behavior (such as setting employee references and formatting dates) to PerformanceTracker objects within the OrangeHRM performance plugin. It utilizes traits for ORM helpers and date-time formatting.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for PerformanceTracker entities, providing methods to set employee references by employee number and retrieve formatted date strings for added and modified dates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a PerformanceTracker object.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee associated with the performance tracker by employee number.

methods.name: setAddedByByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the 'added by' employee reference using an employee number.

methods.name: getAddedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted date when the performance tracker was added.

methods.name: getModifiedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted date when the performance tracker was last modified.
